verdict.rationale: Graphite's CLI and stacking model let users manipulate many branches/PRs at once (community confirms 'rebase multiple branches at the same time'), the merge queue lands multiple PRs in order, and cross-repo PR tracking/AI review runs across all PRs in a repo automatically. However, the AI/agent features (Graphite Agent, chat, fix suggestions) are documented as per-PR actions, not as a bulk/batch operation across many items simultaneously. Missing for 10: explicit bulk AI-agent operations (e.g., batch-generate or batch-fix across many PRs/repos in one command), and independent evidence of scale beyond git-stack rebasing.
